_what: D169 MARGIN_CF population, committed BEFORE any scoring, as D169 step 2 requires.
_definition: robot questions RELEASED in HEALTHY-regime windows (the D162 window rule: the observed first-token p50 of the question's own 100 s submit window <= 2.781 s) in the rq30 paired cells of v5-rules-2 and hybrid-F-lhreq-noc3 at seeds 4, 5, 6 and 7.
_why_this_population: D157 (2)'s four WARM-ALL cells were structurally unable to meet D168's minimum: they yielded 16 healthy-window robot questions against a required 40, because the cells that released robot questions were mostly collapsed and the one with 12 healthy windows released none. These cells are v5-rules-2 (full v5's own base) and its no-C3 base, are independent of the D162 fit (which used warm-all-lru-reactive sweep cells), and contain no full-v5 cell.

thresholds.rule: if either is unmet the margin is NOT set and n is reported (D169 step 3)

error_formula: 0.250 x |P_hat(on time) - 1[actually on time]| per question, p90 over the population, set ONCE
